format.name: Standard
format.desc: Current Play! Pokémon constructed. 60 cards. Regulation H, I, J, and later, from the second Friday after release. Delta Reign is legal from its release date. Older printings of those same cards are legal too, including a new copy as soon as it is released (2026 rotation).

attacks.name: Poisonous Ploy
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Crushing Arrow
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Sniper's Eye
abilities.text: If your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
